changeSet.author: nexus-l3yuc.1
changeSet.comment: nexus.memory gains quarantined_at and rolled_up_at (nullable TIMESTAMPTZ) and a partial index over the quarantined rows. Additive: every existing row keeps both columns NULL.
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE nexus.memory ADD COLUMN quarantined_at TIMESTAMPTZ, ADD COLUMN rolled_up_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
-- Partial: only the quarantined population is ever read by this key -- (listQuarantined, reap, the rollup producer). Live rows stay out of it. CREATE INDEX idx_memory_tenant_quarantined_at ON nexus.memory (tenant_id, quarantined_at) WHERE quarantined_at IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: nexus-l3yuc.1
changeSet.comment: Create nexus.memory_summaries: one row per rollup summary, its source ids as provenance (BIGINT[], not a foreign key: the sources are meant to be reaped once the summary exists).
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE nexus.memory_summaries ( id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, project TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL, source_ids BIGINT[] NOT NULL, produced_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), model TEXT NOT NULL, produced_by TEXT, CONSTRAINT memory_summaries_pk PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT memory_summaries_content_nonempty_chk CHECK (length(content) > 0), CONSTRAINT memory_summaries_source_ids_nonempty_chk CHECK (cardinality(source_ids) > 0) );
CREATE INDEX idx_memory_summaries_tenant_project ON nexus.memory_summaries (tenant_id, project);
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.memory_summaries CASCADE

changeSet.author: nexus-l3yuc.1
changeSet.comment: Enable and force RLS on nexus.memory_summaries; create its own tenant_isolation policy (row-level security is per table).
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE nexus.memory_summaries ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE nexus.memory_summaries FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
-- cmd=ALL: covers SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE in one policy. -- USING predicate: filters rows on reads (SELECT / UPDATE source / DELETE source). -- WITH CHECK predicate: validates rows on writes (INSERT / UPDATE target). -- current_setting('nexus.tenant', true): missing_ok=true so unset GUC returns NULL -- rather than raising an error. NULL != any tenant_id → zero rows match. -- This is the fail-closed default: an unstamped connection sees nothing. CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON nexus.memory_summaries USING (tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true)) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true));
